pa.s: mmary for 7321/8-2S According to the well report, 7321/8-2S was drilled in 2020 in the Barents Sea. TD was reached at 1899 in Late Triassic rocks. The well was plugged and abandoned as dry hole. FIS analysis was performed on total of 56 cuttings samples from 830-1090 m.
